summary: Backend + Frontend testing of new Email/Password (JWT) auth on Libroteca AI. 12/12 backend tests pass (login/me, register + 15 credits, duplicate email 400 IT, brute-force lockout, forgot->log scrape->reset with single-use token, refresh, logout, JWT protected route regression via cookie + Bearer). 11/11 frontend flows pass (landing CTA buttons -> /login, /login tabs & google btn present, wrong password shows 'Email o password non validi' via auth-error, ProtectedRoute redirect, successful login lands on /dashboard with credits, registration lands on /dashboard, forgot-password success message, avatar-menu logout blocks /dashboard, reset-password ?token=XXX updates password and navigates to /login, missing-token shows reset-invalid-token).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1291 lines — consider splitting auth/books/generation into modules for maintainability.
reset-password endpoint field is `password` (not `new_password`) — consistent with frontend; documented via Pydantic model.
get_current_user correctly supports both JWT (cookie/Bearer) and Emergent Google session_token — regression verified.
Emails are stored lowercased server-side (good). Responses echo the lowercased email; make sure any client comparing user input to server response uses case-insensitive equality.
Brute-force lockout counter resets after lockout window elapses via delete on check_lockout — fine, but consider also decrementing/expiring the count itself with a TTL index to avoid stale counters.
seed_data_creation: Tests create disposable users prefixed with TEST_ for register/brute-force/forgot flows; not cleaned up but isolated by uuid suffix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth email/password is fully green. AI generation endpoints (/api/generate/*) NOT tested — Emergent LLM Key budget exhausted per main agent. Reset-password JSON field is `password`, not `new_password`. Logout button lives inside header avatar dropdown ([aria-haspopup='menu']) then data-testid=logout-btn.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in this iteration.
